items.model_hypothesis: Use 'надмасивна' as an in-world comparison among artificial black holes, not the astronomical category. An initial mass near 126,000 tonnes gives an idealized Hawking evaporation lifetime about 5.33 years; 228 tonnes corresponds to about one second under the same approximation.
items.applied: P234 preserves 'надмасивна' in the comparative sense and states about 126,000 tonnes at creation and 228 tonnes in the last second.
items.scientific_limit: The astrophysical class 'supermassive black hole' means hundreds of thousands to billions of solar masses; the story's term is explicitly relative and fictional. Other explosion/push physics remains unresolved.
